title: carex hebecarpa subsp. ligulata
intro: Carex hebecarpa subsp. ligulata, commonly known as the ligulate sedge, is a plant species belonging to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Carex hebecarpa subsp. ligulata are thought to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and lignans, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. However, further research is needed to confirm the specific health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant species.
